parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the data migration, synchronization, or subscribe instance.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: Endpoint
parameters.description:
The database to which the account belongs. Valid values:

- **src**: the source database.
- **dest**: the destination database.

> This parameter is required.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description:
The new password for the database account.
> This parameter is required and must be different from the current password.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- This parameter is required only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: The username of the database account to modify.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:
- **true**
- **false**.
